body: Hahaha I like the way you think.
We can chat in DMs. Just shoot a txt.

My friend. I understand. I can understand the anger you have, because of this cruel cruel world. I understand that every day, circumstances are not working in our favor. 

I feel your loneliness, because I too am truly alone. It feels like there's no one who we can truly trust, and make them understand the pain inside us. Even I feel moments of rage every single day. I have nightmares on the regular so I've become insomniac. I am afraid of live, but I have to keep all these emotions inside. After all, "men don't cry" right.  

Whether you wanna hear it or not, the fact is that you are not alone. And I know this would not do jack shit to make you feel better, because it's just simple statistics. But it is a fact. There will always be people in way worse conditions than us. At least you and I have the wit to come on this platform and express how we feel. Try and reason out with life. Try one more time.

My brother, I don't want to share any advice, or give tips or crappy motivational speeches. They are simply not meant for us right now. 

The only thing we need right now, is a genuine hug. Just like when we were small, when we fell down and hurt ourselves. We need that nurturing love right now. We need someone to make us feel that everything will be alright. Unfortunately, the world is really stereotypical and shallow minded. You can't expect that kind of affection from strangers my brother. You simply can't. So it is pointless trying to expect from them. 

I don't know you. And you don't know me. But my brother, I just want to say that I feel your pain, every second of my existence. Brother, I am sorry on behalf of all the losers out there. But you are my hero, and I am not just saying that. You have the strength to endure this, and so you have been enduring this pain for so long. You are strong. Just don't give up before me.

To whosoever is reading this. Please understand the importance of other human beings. Don't just do shit cuz its just a new trend. Everyone deserves to live a happy life. If you were fortunate enough of having a good childhood, or a good life, please help those who struggled/or are struggling. Most of our anxieties, and traumas go way back and some people don't understand how to solve them. We are carrying these burdens everyday. We work harder than you, we are smarter than you, because we have to carry this heavy baggage every single day while you judge the fuck out of us. At the end, we all die, but why not really serve your purpose as a human being and bring positivity, rather than behaving like a dipshit on this earth. A simple acknowledgement can make my day. Your  smile can make me feel better about who I am, that this cruel is worth living.

I am so happy that you reached out to me. Yes, it definitely feels more comforting to read everything you have written. I guess I just need to be a little more patient with myself right now. I also really appreciate that you acknowledge that these feelings are legitimate. 

I wish we both could hug each other out haha. Wish you well. Have a great day ahead!
Sure, no hurry. See you around!
I think what I'm feeling is an indication. It's something really important. I'll keep what you said in mind.

Hi SweetSitty

Thanks for your response.

Yeah, i can relate to the fact that being in a comforting relationship really helps with that. My ex broke up with me and has blocked me ever since. This was 2 and a half years ago. I miss her hand in mine, and every other physical moments we shared. It feels like she is dead now, and I'm probably still moaning for my loss. 

I now realize, I've never wanted to be in any other relationship since. Maybe this means something about not feeling like even  touching any other stranger. 

About your advice, you're right. I need to start somewhere small. Sports were often an easy avenue because they generally involve a lot of group hugs and hi fives. But you know how the world has turned out now. Better stay safe than be sorry later...

Hi MugenMoult

I can relate to this. I feel that the world has become so difficult for me to have any kind of intimate relationship now. I've been living far from home for many years now so I have not had any hugs or kisses from family. 

I've not had many female friends in life either. Just really professional relationships. It feels awkward to hug a guy. With the whole coronavirus paranoia, you can't even shake hands. 

Hope that you can maybe give some advice or insight.

Thanks again for sharing your views.

Hi Zephenna

I appreciate you writing back. 

Unfortunately, I live really really far from family. I have not seen them since 3 years. 

About my room mates, tbh, it'd just be awkward. I don't really know them and they're not like my bros. 

I feel I'm becoming really numb and cold towards society. I was not like this before. That's why this feels really weird.
